en.hook: COWS RAN AWAY FROM HONKING HORNS?! Srinivas' Headphone Trick! 🐮✨
en.bedtimeHook: A Hilarious Bedtime Tale of Finding Peace & Clever Solutions

protagonists.name: Sringeri Srinivas
protagonists.role: Gentle Village Farmer with Very Long Hair

audio.text: Terlalu Banyak Suara! Ditulis oleh Rohini Nilekani, diilustrasikan oleh Angie dan Upesh.

en.text: Too Much Noise! Written by Rohini Nilekani, illustrated by Angie and Upesh.

audio.text: Suatu hari, Sringeri Srinivas si petani berambut panjang berangkat bersama sapi-sapi terbaiknya menuju pekan ternak. Mereka harus berjalan menyusuri jalan raya nasional baru yang dibangun di dekat desanya.

en.text: One day, Sringeri Srinivas, the farmer, set out with his best cows to the cattle fair. He had to walk along the new national highway that had come up near his village.

audio.text: Jalan raya besar itu sangat ramai dengan mobil dan truk. Setiap pengemudi membunyikan klakson dengan sangat kencang. Paoon! Ponn! Paaa! Sapi-sapi itu sama sekali tidak suka kebisingan ini. Mereka berbalik dan kabur pulang ke rumah!

en.text: That big road had many cars and trucks. Every driver seemed to be honking loudly. Paoon! Ponn! Paaa! The cows did not like the noise at all. They decided to go back home.

audio.text: Srinivas melambaikan tangannya meminta para pengemudi berhenti. Tetapi melihatnya, mereka malah membunyikan klakson lebih keras lagi! Suara bising itu masuk tepat ke dalam kepalanya dan tertahan di sana. Srinivas terpaksa pulang ke kandang bersama sapi-sapinya.

en.text: He waved his hands at the drivers to stop the noise. This did not help. Seeing him, they just honked louder! The noise of the horns went straight into his head, and it stayed there. He went back home with his cows.

audio.text: Tetapi suara bising itu tidak mau pergi dari kepalanya! Paoon! Ponn! Paaa! Bunyi itu terus berputar seperti kelompok musik yang kacau. Suara-suara lain di sekitarnya pun ikut terdengar bising. Bunyi yang biasa ia dengar setiap hari mendadak terasa teramat nyaring.

en.text: But the noise simply would not go away from his head. Paoon! Ponn! Paaa! It kept on playing like a band of untrained musicians. Other noises around him soon joined in. Even the sounds he heard daily suddenly became too loud for Sringeri Srinivas.

audio.text: Suara katak terdengar memekakkan telinga. Derik jangkrik terasa teramat keras. Srinivas bahkan ingin burung hantu diusir pergi! Ia kesal pada burung koyal yang berkicau nyaring pukul empat pagi, ayam jantan yang berkokok, dan auman harimau di kejauhan!

en.text: The ribbit ribbit of the frogs was noisy. The cicadas and their kirkk kirkk were too loud. Sringeri Srinivas wanted the hooting owls to be sent away. He was angry at the koyals for screeching loudly at four in the morning, and the roosters, and that tiger's roar!

audio.text: Kasihan Sringeri Srinivas. Telinganya terasa perih seperti luka baru. Ia berteriak pada anak-anak yang berbicara terlalu keras. Ia memelototi istrinya, Parvatamma, saat panci presto berbunyi mendesis-desis di dapur!

en.text: Poor Sringeri Srinivas. His ears had become raw, like a fresh wound. He shouted at the children if they talked loudly. He glared at his wife Parvatamma when the pressure cooker whistled and whistled in the kitchen!

audio.text: Sringeri Srinivas hanya mendambakan ketenangan. Semua warga desa berusaha membantu. Parvatamma berhenti mengomeli anak-anak. Anak-anak bermain kriket dengan bola yang sangat lembut dan tanpa suara. Sapi-sapi berhenti melenguh, dan burung hantu terbang ke desa lain.

en.text: Sringeri Srinivas only wanted silence. Everyone tried to help. Parvatamma stopped scolding the children. The children played cricket quietly with a very soft ball. The cows did not moo anymore, and the owls moved away to another village.

audio.text: Namun Srinivas masih belum bahagia. Ia bahkan bisa mendengar suara orang-orang yang bersusah payah untuk diam! 'Aku akan pergi dari tempat berisik ini!' serunya suatu pagi. Parvatamma memohon agar ia tidak pergi, tetapi Srinivas tetap melangkah meninggalkan desanya.

en.text: Yet Sringeri Srinivas was not happy. He could hear the noise of everyone trying to be silent! 'I will go away from this place,' he declared one morning. Parvatamma asked where he would find silence, but Srinivas simply walked away from his village.

audio.text: Ia tiba di sebuah kota yang tak kalah bisingnya. Tiba-tiba seorang pemuda lewat dengan kabel menggantung di telinganya. Ada bunyi musik ting dang ting dang. Pemuda itu terlihat sangat santai dan bahagia, sama sekali tidak terganggu oleh klakson truk di sampingnya!

en.text: Soon, he came close to a new town. A young man passed by with wires dangling from his ears. A happy ting dang ting dang sound played. The young man looked relaxed and cheerful, not even noticing the loud trucks blaring horns nearby!

audio.text: 'Benda apa ini?' tanya Srinivas. 'Ini headphone-ku. Cobalah!' kata pemuda itu. Musik merdu terdengar! Tidak ada bunyi klakson! 'Aha! Inilah yang kubutuhkan!' seru Srinivas. Ia langsung membeli sepasang headphone terbaik dan pulang ke desa dengan senyum lebar.

en.text: 'What is this?' he asked. 'These are my headphones. Try them on,' the young man said. Music! Ting dang ting dang! No horns! 'Aha! This is just what I need!' said Srinivas. He bought the best headphones, and returned to his village with a wide smile.

audio.text: Kini, saat Srinivas merasa terganggu oleh suara mobil atau katak, ia cukup memasang headphonenya dan menikmati musik damai. Di desa, sapi-sapi kembali melenguh riang, dan burung-burung berkicau gembira. Namun mobil di jalan raya masih berisik. Srinivas menatap sapi-sapinya... Mungkinkah sapi-sapi itu juga butuh headphone?

en.text: Now, when Srinivas gets bothered by cars or noisy frogs, he puts on his headphones and listens to peaceful music. In the village, cows are mooing and birds are singing happily again. But on the highway, cars are still noisy. Sringeri Srinivas looks at his cows... Will they want headphones too?

moral.headline: Ketenangan Bisa Ditemukan dengan Solusi Cerdas!
moral.headlineEn: Peace Can Always Be Found with Clever Thinking!

audio.text: Pesan moral cerita ini: Di dunia yang penuh kebisingan dan kesibukan, kita selalu bisa menemukan ketenangan jika bersikap tenang dan mencari solusi cerdas. Jangan biarkan kekesalan merusak hubungan kita dengan orang-orang tercinta di sekitar kita!

en.text: The moral of the story: In a world full of noise and hurry, we can always find peace by staying calm and thinking creatively. Never let frustration hurt our relationships with the loved ones around us!
